issue_request: FHIR-27866 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to replace the former Invoice.date with Invoice.creation 0..1 dateTime, Invoice.period[x] 0..1 date | Period, and Invoice.lineItem.serviced[x] 0..1 date | Period so invoices can identify the applicable billing or service period.
initial_application: No available commit explicitly mentions FHIR-27866. The change appears to have been applied implicitly by a86020d78d769d63c73b763fa178571cd4703ff1, which added Invoice.creation, Invoice.period[x], and Invoice.lineItem.serviced[x] but introduced the serviced[x] short-text typo. Later commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed the deprecated Invoice.date source element.
additional_context: Invoice is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini maps the former Invoice.date to Invoice.period[x] while marking Invoice.creation and Invoice.lineItem.serviced[x] as additions. Jira searches found FHIR-27866 as the only direct Invoice period/serviced issue; direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or meeting record.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit correcting source/invoice/structuredefinition-Invoice.xml so Invoice.lineItem.serviced[x] now has the short description 'Service date or period'. No broader StructureDefinition change was needed because Invoice.creation and Invoice.period[x] already match the resolution's requested element shapes.
